Finally, there is uncertainty.
You possess the self-awareness to recognize when you are unsure about an answer.
Because an AI lacks a mind to be self-aware, it can synthesize completely incorrect information
and deliver it with absolute certainty.
The result is a perfect mirror.
Similar-looking answers can be produced by vastly different underlying processes.
Pointing this out does not mean artificial intelligence is useless.
These tools can summarize legal documents, write complex code, and do highly impressive, valuable work at massive scale.

Here is the setup.
People standing outside the room slide a note written in Chinese under the door.
It asks, how are you?
The person inside cannot read a bit of it.
Instead, they simply take those unfamiliar shapes and visually match them on a giant
look-up chart.
They blindly follow the rulebook's instructions, select the exact matching set of symbols
for the reply, and slide it back out.
To anyone outside, it looks like fluent Chinese conversation.
But the person inside comprehends nothing.
A convincing answer doesn't prove understanding.
